extra_vocab.en: the fact of being present at a meeting or event
extra_vocab.note: 文章裡的 confirm your attendance 是請員工回信告知「是否會出席」會議。多益的通知信常用這個字要求確認出席。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: attendance 是不可數名詞，不加 s；說「出席某場合」用 attendance at + 場合。

example.en: Please confirm attendance with HR before the end of this week.
example.zh: 請在本週結束前向人資確認出席。

example.en: Her attendance record shows she has never missed a team meeting.
example.zh: 她的出勤紀錄顯示她從未缺席過團隊會議。

example.en: More than fifty customers were in attendance at the product launch.
example.zh: 超過五十位顧客出席了新產品發表會。

example.en: The trainer will take attendance at the start of each session.
example.zh: 講師會在每堂課開始時點名。

examples.en: Attendance at the monthly sales meeting is required for all managers.
examples.zh: 所有經理都必須出席每月的業務會議。

examples.en: Thank you for confirming your attendance at the client dinner.
examples.zh: 謝謝你確認出席客戶晚宴。

examples.en: Regular attendance is necessary to receive the training certificate.
examples.zh: 要拿到訓練證書，必須規律出席。

confusable.diff: 拼法與發音都接近 attendance；attention 是「注意力、關注」，不是出席。

example.en: Please give your full attention to the new meeting schedule.
example.zh: 請全神貫注看這份新的會議時間表。

confusable.diff: 與 attendance 意思相反；absence 是缺席、不在場。

example.en: Please inform your manager of any absence before the meeting begins.
example.zh: 會議開始前，請先告知主管你是否缺席。

similar.diff: presence 強調「人在現場」的狀態，語氣較正式；attendance 側重出席會議或活動這件事（或出席人數）。

example.en: Your presence at the opening ceremony would mean a lot to us.
example.zh: 您出席開幕典禮對我們意義重大。

example.en: Every participant must sign in at the front desk.
example.zh: 每位參加者都必須在櫃台簽到。

example.en: The guest speaker arrived at the hotel an hour early.
example.zh: 受邀的講者提早一小時抵達飯店。

example.en: Online registration for the seminar closes this Friday afternoon.
example.zh: 研討會的線上報名在本週五下午截止。

derived.link: attend + -ance，把「出席」這個動作變成名詞，像 appearance（appear）、performance（perform）

example.en: All managers must attend the quarterly planning meeting on Monday.
example.zh: 所有經理都必須出席週一的季度規劃會議。

derived.link: attend + -ee，接受動作或參加的人，像 employee、trainee

example.en: Each attendee will receive a folder with the conference schedule.
example.zh: 每位出席者都會拿到附有會議日程的資料夾。

example.en: The parking attendant showed visitors where to leave their cars.
example.zh: 停車場服務員告訴訪客把車停在哪裡。

senses.en: being present at a meeting or an event

example.en: Your attendance at the training workshop is required next Tuesday.
example.zh: 下週二的訓練工作坊必須請你出席。

senses.en: the number of people who come to an event
senses.distinguish: 句中談的是「來了多少人」時是此意，常搭配 reach、increase、drop。

example.en: Attendance at the trade show reached five thousand visitors this year.
example.zh: 今年商展的到場人數達到五千位訪客。
